mechanical_guide: Auth verifies raw signed credential, enforces direct self-security dispatch, retains Company/User/Account/exact family locks and fresh DB clocks through one Auth projection transaction; REST maps typed result and private headers. detection: Reviewed real HTTP A/B revocation probe, privacy controls, supplementary lifetime/tuple/lock histories and retained tests
rollback: Revert unexposed reader change while keeping parser and issuance disabled; restore old behavior only as known unqualified release candidate
stop_conditions: prerequisite failure rather than revoked-A200 RED
broader dispatch or role semantics change
